correctness.rationale: The side-of-own-index invariant is preserved by every legal adjacent swap. Each of the 2^(n-2) patterns has the displayed valid normal form. Legal bubbling first sorts all left-side values, then all right-side values, proving each fiber connected and giving a uniform diameter bound; adjacent swap blocking conditions force exactly two frozen shifts for n>=3. Independently checked BFS for n<=9 and constructive normal-form path for n<=8; finite BFS establishes the 6-letter 7-vs-5 non-isometry witness.

value.rationale: The infinite natural reconfiguration family admits an exact exponential count and a complete path-component invariant. It exhibits reducibility of an otherwise natural adjacent-swap Markov chain, yields a canonical reachability algorithm and exactly identifies all absorbing configurations, and documents nongeodesicity within connected fibers. These are structural facts not implied by the classical subfactorial count or general derangement Gray codes.
